item.title: Lending Is The New Advertising
item.description: In the late 00’s, as the internet age matured in developed countries, advertising became the sexy way to monetise. The strategy for most consumer internet startups was simple - Make it free, get a huge audience (i.e. distribution), and then leverage it for distributing advertisements.
